'''Pianyu''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Pianyu:''' Hello. How can I be of assistance?
:{{DIcon}} About [[Uncle Gao|Gaoyun]] and [[Ruiyun]].
::'''Pianyu:''' Mr. Gao is just too worried about his daughter, that's all. Understandable, that's the way parents are.
::'''Pianyu:''' Ruiyun always talked about how she wanted to go to the frontlines. Now that she's finally doing patrol duty in the residential area, it's not bad of a job actually. And Mr. Gao can also rest easy.
::{{DIcon}} How do you know about Ruiyun?
::'''Pianyu:''' Well, I... I have my ways!
::'''Pianyu:''' Besides, I'm an old friend of Mr. Gao's. So what's the big deal if I know a thing or two about their family?
:{{DIcon}} About [[Doudou]] and [[Mingming]].
::'''Pianyu:''' Ah, the siblings that play hide-and-seek every day. They must be having a lot of fun.
::'''Pianyu:''' It's just that Wulǔ is usually busy doing sentry duty and doesn't have time to spend with his kids.
::'''Pianyu:''' *sigh* I guess he really doesn't have much of a choice.
:{{DIcon}} About Pianyu.
::'''Pianyu:''' Me? I don't mind being on patrol duty. I actually quite enjoy it, roaming around this area.
::'''Pianyu:''' I'm happy as long as I see the residents here living peacefully each day.
::'''Pianyu:''' If there's anything I can help them in any way, I'd be even happier.
{{Dialogue End}}
